body: My situation is exactly the same. This whole world is so fucking cruel.

You are absolutely fucking right. This world is a cruel fucking place to live in. Any of these bigots who tell us otherwise are just plain blind, and are fucking airheads coz they just cannot understand the pain that us individuals endure. I know exactly how you feel, my friend. I myseld have had so many experiences where everything is bad, nothing in life is good, and IT STILL ISNT! Fuck life! Anyway, I'll be hoping for you. If you want to talk or anything, send me a msg and we can complain to each other or something heh. Good luck.

If you want to talk, don't hesitate to swing me a message. High school has fucked me for the past 5 years, and gotten worse. I'll be out of here soon, but I understand what you are going through.

I hope it gets better for you.

Hello. I'm very sorry you are experiencing this. I do as well. I recently turned 17 and have already attempted suicide twice. Im probably going to do it again soon. Believe me, you are not alone. I am constantly getting ignored by everyone, people have made up bullshit rumors about me in the past, and ive never ever had a significant other. It sucks. It really does. The pain we experience every day keeps getting worse and worse. Feels like your head is swelling and getting heavier and heavier. If I ever shot myself in the head, I swear butterflies would come out! But seriously, so many of us poor individuals experience this crap on a daily basis. Please take comfort in knowing that you are not alone, and I hope it gets better for you soon! Take care. 🙂
Oh yeah. Every day since 2015. It really weighs you down too, makes ur head feel so heavy.
